name: @rindle/wiki-demo
description: The tiny machine: a real rindled follower keeps two nested boards (just-edited pages and recent editors) over Wikimedia's live recentchange firehose permanently pinned and fans the live results out to many browsers. A thin Node tier fronts the HCTree master/follower pair with bounded ordered ingestion and pruning.

scripts.build:daemon: cargo build --manifest-path ../../rust/Cargo.toml -p rindle-server --bin rindled -p rindle-replicator --bin rindle-replicator
scripts.build:daemon:release: cargo build --manifest-path ../../rust/Cargo.toml --release --features rindle-replicator/metrics,rindle-server/metrics,rindle-server/analyze -p rindle-server --bin rindled -p rindle-replicator --bin rindle-replicator
